brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
The EU should not turn a blind eye to Montenegro’s bloody clan war. [1]
Montenegro bans EVs on board. [2]
RTCG hosts Eurovision Workshop in Tivat. [3]
Kazakhstan considers using Montenegro's Port of Bar as logistics hub for cargo to Europe. [4]
Court dismisses murder charges in double murder after Montenegro extradition falls through. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR MONTENEGRO
The EU's inaction may enable continued clan violence in Montenegro. [1]

KEY RISKS
The bloody clan war poses a risk of further violence and instability in Montenegro. [1]
The failed extradition risks leaving murder charges unresolved. [5]

WATCH ITEMS
The court dismissed murder charges after the Montenegro extradition fell through. [5]
